answer: Answers are salted with a 132 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Because the tide salt is published after the voyage checkpoint, the ledge audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 31 keys therefore forfeits for 31 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
